learning_outcomes.title: Piecewise functions
learning_outcomes.rule_summary: Use each formula only on its stated interval; show endpoint inclusion.

questions.instruction: Graph the function. State its domain and range.
questions.stem: Graph the function. State its domain and range. f(x)=\begin{cases}\frac12x-1&x>3\\-2x+3&x\le3\end{cases}

parts.prompt: Plot both pieces with correct endpoints; state domain and range.

answer.model_answer_and_marking: Open (3,0.5), slope 1/2 to the right; closed (3,−3), slope −2 to the left. D=ℝ, R=[−3,∞). Slopes and rays (4), endpoints (2), domain (2), range (2).
